tasks.title: Early Hominid Diets and the Function of Stone Tools
paras: One area of paleoanthropological study involves the eating and dietary habits of hominids, erect bipedal primates—including early humans. It is clear that at some stage of history, humans began to carry their food to central places, called home bases, where it was shared and consumed with the young and other adults. The use of home bases is a fundamental component of human social behavior; the common meal served at a common hearth is a powerful symbol, a mark of social unity. Home base behavior does not occur among nonhuman primates and is rare among mammals. It is unclear when humans began to use home bases, what kind of communications and social relations were involved, and what the ecological and food-choice contexts of the shift were.

One innovative approach to these issues involves studying damage and wear on stone tools. Researchers make tools that replicate excavated specimens as closely as possible and then try to use them as the originals might have been used, in woodcutting, hunting, or cultivation. Depending on how the tool is used, characteristic chip page patterns and microscopically distinguishable polishes develop near the edges. The first application of this method of analysis to stone tools that are 1.5 million to 2 million years old indicates that, from the start, an important function of early stone tools was to extract highly nutritious food—meat and marrow-from large animal carcasses.

questions.stem: The passage mainly discusses which of the following aspects of hominid behavior?

options.A: Changes in eating and dietary practices
options.B: The creation of stone hunting tools
options.D: Methods of extracting nutritious food from carcasses

questions.analysis: 题型：主旨题 正确答案：A. Changes in eating and dietary practices 原文定位：第一句指出研究的是“eating and dietary habits of hominids”，后文通过“home base”共享行为与石器分析展开饮食行为讨论。 正确答案分析：整篇聚焦早期人类如何获取和分享食物，属于饮食习惯的变化。 选项分析： B 讲到石器工具，但只是研究饮食行为的方式，不是主旨。 C 讲到社会互动，但只是home base行为的一种社会意义，非主线。 D 提取营养是工具使用的一个方面，不是文章的整体关注点。

questions.stem: According to the passage, bringing a meal to a location to be shared by many individuals is

options.A: an activity typical of nonhuman primates
options.B: a common practice among animals that eat meat
options.D: a behavior that encourages better dietary habits

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：C. an indication of social unity 原文定位：“a mark of social unity”明确指出此行为象征社会凝聚。 正确答案分析：共享食物在home base中体现的是人类的社会组织性。 选项分析： A 与原文不符，文中指出非人类灵长类不具备此行为。 B 原文未提及这种行为与肉食动物有关。 D 没有提到该行为与改善饮食习惯有关。

questions.stem: The word "consumed" in the passage is closest in meaning to
questions.analysis: 题型：词汇题 正确答案：D. eaten 原文定位：“where it was shared and consumed”中，“consumed”指的是食物被吃掉。 正确答案分析：在食物相关语境下，consume 表示“吃掉”。 选项分析： A. prepared（准备）——语义错误，consume 强调的是“食用”，而非预处理。 B. stored（储存）——上下文中没有储存的含义，食物是用来共享和吃的。 C. distributed（分发）——虽然有“共享”行为，但consume 本身不等于 distribute。 D. eaten（吃掉）——与语境最匹配，表示被食用。

questions.stem: According to paragraph 2, researchers make copies of old stone tools in order to

options.A: protect the old tools from being worn out
options.B: display examples of the old tools in museums
options.C: test theories about how old tools were used
options.D: learn how to improve the design of modern tools

questions.analysis: 题型：细节题 正确答案：C. test theories about how old tools were used 原文定位：“try to use them as the originals might have been used”说明研究者模仿使用工具以了解其用途。 正确答案分析：制作仿制品是为了重现使用场景，推测原始工具用途。 选项分析： A 没有提到保护旧工具。 B 未提到展览或博物馆用途。 D 没有涉及现代工具设计优化的问题。

questions.stem: In paragraph 2, the author mentions all of the following as examples of ways in which early stone tools were used EXCEPT to
questions.analysis: 题型：排除列举题 正确答案：A. build home bases 原文定位：文中明确列举了woodcutting（伐木）、hunting（狩猎）、cultivation（耕作）以及提取肉和骨髓。 选项分析： A 是正确答案，因为文中从未提到石器用于建造home bases。 B 是提取肉和骨髓的直接用途，对应“to extract highly nutritious food”。 C 是“hunting”的体现，文中明确提及。 D 是“woodcutting”的体现，也出现在原文中。
